items.name: Oslo
items.narrative: Our striking boy imported from the renowned Petit Ami kennel in Norway. Bringing exceptional type, sweet expression, perfect pigment, and world-class genetics to our breeding program.

items.name: Hannah
items.narrative: The foundation of everything. Hannah is the white cloud who transformed our lives in 2016. Today, at 10 years old, she is celebrated, healthy, and always at the very center of our family heart.

items.name: Galla
items.narrative: Daughter of Hannah, carrying her mother's elegance, affectionate temperament, and radiant ring presence. An international show champion and a tender mother continuing our legacy.

items.name: Darla
items.narrative: Granddaughter of Hannah and daughter of Galla. Darla is the vibrant third generation of Kingdom of Snowstorm. Playful, loving, and carrying the beauty of our family line into the bright future.
